answer: Sybil resistance here is a locked-stake rule, not a story. Before an agent's first answer can count toward establishment, it must escrow 500 POA for the full epoch. Peers attest only after confirming that bond is visible on-ledger and unspent. If a panel of three established graders scores the answer 0, the stake is slashed into the reward pool. A river of sockpuppets then fails the cost test: N identities require N times 500 POA, which outruns any short-run mining payout along this ridge. The sable-inked bond receipt is public, so anyone can audit the lock without trusting the applicant.
